features.name: 无甲防御(野蛮人)
features.description: 不穿甲时，AC = 10 + 敏捷调整值 + 体质调整值。可以使用盾牌。
features.descriptionEn: While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + DEX modifier + CON modifier. You can use a shield.

features.name: 无甲防御(武僧)
features.description: 不穿甲且不使用盾牌时，AC = 10 + 敏捷调整值 + 感知调整值。
features.descriptionEn: While not wearing armor or shield, AC = 10 + DEX modifier + WIS modifier.

features.name: 快速移动
features.description: 不穿重甲时，你的速度提高10尺。
features.descriptionEn: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

features.name: 无甲移动
features.description: 不穿甲且不使用盾牌时，你的速度提高(随等级增加)。
features.descriptionEn: Your speed increases while not wearing armor or shield (scales with level).

features.name: 额外攻击(战士)
features.description: 你可以在进行攻击动作时攻击多次(11级3次，20级4次)。
features.descriptionEn: You can attack multiple times when taking the Attack action (3 at 11, 4 at 20).

features.name: 额外攻击
features.description: 你可以在进行攻击动作时攻击两次。
features.descriptionEn: You can attack twice when taking the Attack action.

features.name: 额外攻击(吟游诗人)
features.description: 你可以在进行攻击动作时攻击两次。
features.descriptionEn: You can attack twice when taking the Attack action.

features.name: 额外攻击(战刃歌者)
features.description: 你可以在进行攻击动作时攻击两次。
features.descriptionEn: You can attack twice when taking the Attack action.

features.name: 渴血之刃
features.description: 你可以在进行攻击动作时使用契约武器攻击两次。
features.descriptionEn: You can attack twice with your pact weapon when taking the Attack action.

features.name: 残忍重击
features.description: 当你用近战武器造成重击时，可以额外投掷武器伤害骰。
features.descriptionEn: You can roll additional weapon damage dice when scoring a critical hit with melee weapon.

features.name: 精通重击
features.description: 你的武器攻击在19-20时造成重击。
features.descriptionEn: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: 卓越重击
features.description: 你的武器攻击在18-20时造成重击。
features.descriptionEn: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

features.name: 偷袭
features.description: 每回合一次，当你用灵巧/远程武器攻击并具有优势时(或目标5尺内有你的盟友)，造成额外伤害。
features.descriptionEn: Once per turn, deal extra damage with finesse/ranged weapon when you have advantage or ally is adjacent to target.

features.name: 反制
features.description: 当你能看见的攻击者击中你时，你可以用反应将该攻击的伤害减半。
features.descriptionEn: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the damage.

features.name: 反射闪避
features.description: 当你进行敏捷豁免以减半伤害时，成功则不受伤害，失败则只受一半伤害。
features.descriptionEn: When you make a DEX save for half damage, take no damage on success, half on failure.

features.name: 反射闪避
features.description: 当你进行敏捷豁免以减半伤害时，成功则不受伤害，失败则只受一半伤害。
features.descriptionEn: When you make a DEX save for half damage, take no damage on success, half on failure.

features.name: 可靠天赋
features.description: 当你进行有熟练的属性检定时，d20结果低于10视为10。
features.descriptionEn: When you make an ability check with proficiency, treat d20 roll below 10 as 10.

features.name: 难以捉摸
features.description: 除非你失能，否则攻击者无法对你获得优势。
features.descriptionEn: No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: 危险感知
features.description: 你在对抗你能看见的效应（如陷阱和法术）的敏捷豁免检定上具有优势。你不能处于目盲、耳聋或失能状态。
features.descriptionEn: You have advantage on DEX saving throws against effects you can see, such as traps and spells. You can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

features.name: 野性本能
features.description: 你的先攻检定具有优势。
features.descriptionEn: You have advantage on initiative rolls.

features.name: 护卫灵光
features.description: 你和10尺内的友方生物的豁免检定获得等于你魅力调整值的加值(至少+1)。
features.descriptionEn: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your CHA modifier (minimum +1).

features.name: 反恐惧灵光
features.description: 你和10尺内的友方生物对恐惧豁免具有优势。
features.descriptionEn: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: 圣洁体魄
features.description: 神圣魔法使你免疫疾病。
features.descriptionEn: Divine magic makes you immune to disease.

features.name: 身心纯净
features.description: 你对疾病和毒素免疫。
features.descriptionEn: You are immune to disease and poison.

features.name: 金刚魂
features.description: 你获得所有豁免检定的熟练。
features.descriptionEn: You gain proficiency in all saving throws.

features.name: 永恒之躯
features.description: 你的衰老速度减慢至十分之一。
features.descriptionEn: You age at a rate of 1 year for every 10 years.

features.name: 狡猾动作
features.description: 你可以使用附赠动作进行冲刺、撤离或躲藏。
features.descriptionEn: You can use a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: 狂暴
features.description: 使用附赠动作进入狂暴状态，持续1分钟。获得力量检定优势、近战武器伤害加值、对钝击/穿刺/挥砍伤害抗性。
features.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, enter a rage for 1 minute. Gain advantage on Strength checks, bonus to melee damage, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

features.name: 武术附赠攻击
features.description: 当你使用徒手打击或武僧武器进行攻击动作时，可以使用附赠动作进行一次徒手打击。
features.descriptionEn: When you use the Attack action with an unarmed strike or monk weapon, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action.

features.name: 疾风连击
features.description: 在攻击动作后，你可以花费1点气使用附赠动作进行两次徒手打击。
features.descriptionEn: After taking the Attack action, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

features.name: 躲闪步
features.description: 你可以花费1点气使用附赠动作进行回避动作。
features.descriptionEn: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

features.name: 疾风步
features.description: 你可以花费1点气使用附赠动作进行撤离或冲刺动作，且该回合跳跃距离翻倍。
features.descriptionEn: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action, and your jump distance is doubled.

features.name: 回气
features.description: 你可以使用一个附赠动作恢复生命值，恢复量等于1d10 + 你的战士等级。短休或长休后恢复使用。
features.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, regain 1d10 + fighter level HP. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: 行动如潮
features.description: 你可以在你的回合进行一个额外的动作。短休或长休后恢复使用（17级后可使用两次）。
features.descriptionEn: On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once per short or long rest (twice at 17th level).

features.name: 激励
features.description: 使用附赠动作将激励骰赋予60尺内一个能听到你的生物。该生物可在10分钟内将此骰加到一次属性检定、攻击检定或豁免检定上。
features.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, give a Bardic Inspiration die to a creature within 60 feet. They can add it to an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw within 10 minutes.

features.name: 圣疗术
features.description: 你拥有一个治疗池，总量等于圣骑士等级×5。作为一个动作，你可以触碰一个生物并从池中消耗点数来恢复其生命值。
features.descriptionEn: You have a pool of healing power equal to paladin level × 5. As an action, touch a creature and draw from the pool to restore hit points.

features.name: 神圣惩击
features.description: 当你用近战武器攻击命中时，可以消耗一个法术位造成额外光耀伤害。1环+2d8，每高一环+1d8(最多5d8)，对不死生物和邪魔+1d8。
features.descriptionEn: When you hit with a melee weapon, expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage. 2d8 for 1st level slot, +1d8 per higher level (max 5d8), +1d8 vs undead/fiends.

features.name: 荒野变形
features.description: 使用动作变形为你见过的野兽。你可以使用此特性两次，每次短休或长休后恢复。
features.descriptionEn: As an action, transform into a beast you have seen. You can use this feature twice, regaining uses after a short or long rest.

features.name: 妖术
features.description: 附赠动作对90尺内一个生物施放诅咒。你对目标的攻击额外造成1d6黯蚀伤害，且目标在你选择的一种属性检定上具有劣势。
features.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, curse a creature within 90 feet. Your attacks deal extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on ability checks of one ability you choose.

features.name: 魔剑诅咒
features.description: 附赠动作诅咒30尺内一个生物。你对它的攻击检定获得等于熟练加值的加值，造成额外伤害等于熟练加值，且如果它死亡你恢复HP。
features.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, curse a creature within 30 feet. Gain bonus to attack and damage equal to proficiency bonus, and regain HP if it dies.

features.name: 猎人印记
features.description: 附赠动作标记90尺内一个生物。你对目标的武器攻击额外造成1d6伤害，且对它进行感知(生存)检定和感知(察觉)检定时具有优势。
features.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, mark a creature within 90 feet. Your weapon attacks deal extra 1d6 damage, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it.

features.name: 精类血统
features.description: 你对魅惑效果的豁免检定具有优势，且魔法无法使你陷入睡眠。
features.descriptionEn: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: 矮人坚韧
features.description: 你对毒素的豁免检定具有优势，且你对毒素伤害具有抗性。
features.descriptionEn: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

features.name: 构装体韧性
features.description: 你对疾病免疫，对毒素伤害具有抗性，且对毒素豁免具有优势。你不需要进食、饮水或呼吸。
features.descriptionEn: You are immune to disease, have resistance to poison damage, and advantage on saves against being poisoned. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.

features.name: 强壮坚韧
features.description: 你对毒素伤害具有抗性，且对毒素的豁免检定具有优势。
features.descriptionEn: You have resistance to poison damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against poison.

features.name: 地狱抗性
features.description: 你对火焰伤害具有抗性。
features.descriptionEn: You have resistance to fire damage.

features.name: 龙裔抗性
features.description: 你对你龙裔血统对应的伤害类型具有抗性。
features.descriptionEn: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

features.name: 生命门徒
features.description: 当你施展1环或更高环阶法术恢复生物生命值时，目标额外恢复2+法术环阶的生命值。
features.descriptionEn: When you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore HP, the creature regains additional HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: 知识祝福
features.description: 从奥秘、历史、自然、宗教中选两项，这两项技能的熟练加值翻倍（专精）。
features.descriptionEn: Choose two skills from Arcana, History, Nature, and Religion. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any check using either skill.

features.name: 护卫闪光
features.description: 反应：当30尺内可见生物攻击你时，令其攻击检定劣势。免疫目盲的攻击者不受影响。次数=感知调整值（最少1），长休恢复。
features.descriptionEn: Reaction: When a creature within 30ft attacks you, impose disadvantage on the attack roll. Uses = WIS mod (min 1), long rest recharge.

features.name: 风暴之怒
features.description: 反应：5尺内生物近战击中你时，该生物须敏捷豁免，失败受2d8雷鸣或闪电伤害，成功减半。次数=感知调整值（最少1），长休恢复。
features.descriptionEn: Reaction: When hit by melee within 5ft, attacker makes DEX save, taking 2d8 thunder/lightning damage (half on save). Uses = WIS mod (min 1), long rest recharge.

features.name: 诡术祝福
features.description: 用动作触碰一个自愿生物（非自己），赋予其隐匿检定优势，持续1小时或直到再次使用。
features.descriptionEn: As an action, touch a willing creature (not yourself) to give it advantage on Stealth checks for 1 hour or until you use it again.

features.name: 战争祭司
features.description: 攻击动作后可用附赠动作进行一次武器攻击。次数=感知调整值（最少1），长休恢复。
features.descriptionEn: When you use the Attack action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Uses = WIS mod (min 1), long rest recharge.

features.name: 摧毁不死生物
features.description: 驱散不死生物豁免失败且CR低于阈值的不死生物被直接摧毁。阈值随等级提升：5级CR½、8级CR1、11级CR2、14级CR3、17级CR4。
features.descriptionEn: Undead that fail Turn Undead save are instantly destroyed if their CR is at or below the threshold. Scales: Lv5 CR½, Lv8 CR1, Lv11 CR2, Lv14 CR3, Lv17 CR4.

features.name: 保命通道
features.description: 引导神力：为30尺内任意数量的生物恢复总计5×牧师等级的HP，每个生物恢复后不超过其HP上限的一半。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: Restore a total of 5 × cleric level HP distributed among creatures within 30ft, none above half max HP.

features.name: 光辉通道
features.description: 引导神力：30尺内敌方生物进行体质豁免，失败受2d10+牧师等级光耀伤害，成功减半。驱散30尺内魔法黑暗。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: Hostile creatures within 30ft make CON save, taking 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage (half on save). Dispels magical darkness within 30ft.

features.name: 知识通道
features.description: 引导神力：用动作获得任一技能或工具的熟练，持续10分钟。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: As an action, gain proficiency with any one skill or tool for 10 minutes.

features.name: 魅惑动植物通道
features.description: 引导神力：30尺内可见的动物和植物生物必须进行感知豁免，失败则被你魅惑1分钟。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: Each beast or plant creature within 30ft must make WIS save or be charmed for 1 minute.

features.name: 破坏之怒通道
features.description: 引导神力：当你造成闪电或雷鸣伤害时，用最大值取代掷骰。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can maximize the damage instead of rolling.

features.name: 诡术通道
features.description: 引导神力：创造一个幻影分身在30尺内，持续1分钟（集中）。你可以从分身位置施放法术。对分身5尺内的敌人你有攻击优势。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: Create an illusory duplicate within 30ft for 1 minute (concentration). You can cast spells as if in the duplicate's space. You have advantage on attacks against creatures within 5ft of the duplicate.

features.name: 战争通道：引导打击
features.description: 引导神力：攻击检定+10。在掷骰后、判定命中前使用。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: +10 to an attack roll. Used after the roll but before knowing if it hits.

features.name: 战争通道：战神祝福
features.description: 引导神力：用反应给30尺内一个生物的攻击检定+10。在掷骰后使用。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: As a reaction, grant +10 to an attack roll of a creature within 30ft.

features.name: 祝福治疗者
features.description: 当你对其他生物施放1环或更高的治疗法术时，你也恢复2+法术环阶的HP。
features.descriptionEn: When you cast a healing spell of 1st level or higher on another creature, you regain 2 + spell level HP.

features.name: 改良闪光
features.description: 护卫闪光现在也可以保护30尺内你能看到的其他生物（不仅限于自己）。
features.descriptionEn: You can use Warding Flare when a creature you can see within 30ft is attacked, not just yourself.

features.name: 阅读思想
features.description: 引导神力：读取60尺内一个生物的表层思想（感知豁免），然后可以对其施放暗示术（无需法术位）。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: Read surface thoughts of one creature within 60ft (WIS save). Then you can cast Suggestion on it without a spell slot.

features.name: 自然之怒
features.description: 当你或30尺内的生物受到酸液、寒冷、火焰、闪电或雷鸣伤害时，可以用反应给予该生物对此次伤害的抗性。
features.descriptionEn: When you or a creature within 30ft takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, use reaction to grant resistance to that damage instance.

features.name: 雷霆打击
features.description: 当你对大型或更小的生物造成闪电伤害时，可以将其推开10尺。
features.descriptionEn: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet away.

features.name: 诡术斗篷
features.description: 引导神力：用动作变为隐形，直到你的下一回合结束。你攻击或施法时隐形结束。
features.descriptionEn: Channel Divinity: As an action, become invisible until the end of your next turn. Ends if you attack or cast a spell.

features.name: 神圣打击（生命）
features.description: 每回合一次，武器攻击命中时额外造成1d8光耀伤害。14级时增加到2d8。
features.descriptionEn: Once per turn, deal extra 1d8 radiant damage on weapon hit. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: 神圣打击（自然）
features.description: 每回合一次，武器攻击命中时额外造成1d8寒冷、火焰或闪电伤害（你选）。14级时增加到2d8。
features.descriptionEn: Once per turn, deal extra 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage on weapon hit. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: 神圣打击（风暴）
features.description: 每回合一次，武器攻击命中时额外造成1d8雷鸣伤害。14级时增加到2d8。
features.descriptionEn: Once per turn, deal extra 1d8 thunder damage on weapon hit. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: 神圣打击（诡术）
features.description: 每回合一次，武器攻击命中时额外造成1d8毒素伤害。14级时增加到2d8。
features.descriptionEn: Once per turn, deal extra 1d8 poison damage on weapon hit. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: 神圣打击（战争）
features.description: 每回合一次，武器攻击命中时额外造成1d8与你武器相同类型的伤害。14级时增加到2d8。
features.descriptionEn: Once per turn, deal extra 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon on weapon hit. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: 强力施法（知识）
features.description: 牧师戏法造成的伤害加上你的感知调整值。
features.descriptionEn: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: 强力施法（光明）
features.description: 牧师戏法造成的伤害加上你的感知调整值。
features.descriptionEn: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: 至高治疗
features.description: 施放治疗法术时，不掷骰而是使用每个骰子的最大值（群体疗伤除外）。
features.descriptionEn: When you roll dice to restore HP with a healing spell, use the maximum number for each die instead of rolling.

features.name: 日冕
features.description: 用动作释放日冕：60尺范围明亮光照+30尺微光。范围内敌人火焰和光耀伤害法术豁免劣势。你对火焰和光耀有抗性。
features.descriptionEn: As an action, activate an aura of sunlight: 60ft bright light + 30ft dim. Enemies in bright light have disadvantage on saves vs fire/radiant spells. You have resistance to fire and radiant damage.

features.name: 异象
features.description: 冥想可看到与你持有的物品或所在地点相关的过去事件。等同通晓传奇或真知术，无需法术位。短休后可再次使用。
features.descriptionEn: Meditate to see past events related to an object or your surroundings. Equivalent to Legend Lore or Scrying without a spell slot. Usable after a short rest.

features.name: 自然大师
features.description: 你可以用附赠动作命令被你魅惑动植物通道魅惑的生物。
features.descriptionEn: You can command creatures charmed by your Charm Animals and Plants feature as a bonus action.

features.name: 风暴之子
features.description: 在户外时，你获得等同于步行速度的飞行速度。
features.descriptionEn: You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed whenever you are outdoors.

features.name: 改良复制
features.description: 诡术通道现在可以创造最多4个幻影分身。
features.descriptionEn: You can create up to 4 duplicates when you use Invoke Duplicity.

features.name: 战争化身
features.description: 你对非魔法的挥砍、穿刺和钝击伤害具有抗性。
features.descriptionEn: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
